title: delphinium fissum subsp. bolosii
intro: Delphinium fissum subsp. bolosii, commonly known as the Bolos' delphinium or Bolos's larkspur, is a plant species belonging to the Delphinium genus. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which can help alleviate various health issues such as fever, cough, and respiratory problems. The therapeutic actions of Delphinium fissum subsp. bolosii include its ability to act as an expectorant, helping to relieve coughs and congestion, and its anti-inflammatory properties, which can help reduce swelling and pain. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, flavonoids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
